Image 1 is the ART STYLE reference ONLY — do NOT draw that young man; draw the new woman described below. Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern cel animation with a light, airy palette — thin coloured lineart (dark lavender instead of black), flat pastel colours with one soft-edged but still flat shadow tone, simple clean backgrounds with a few round lights, gentle and romantic like an anime film. Hand-drawn feel, NOT glossy: no airbrush gradients, no bloom, no heavy glow, no over-detailed strands. Realistic adult proportions (about 7 heads tall, not chibi), a beautiful adult face. Original character, not a real person.

Shirogane Tsubaki, 20, the sheltered young lady of an old ryokan family, at her very first crowded New Year shrine visit. Elegant, polite and composed, but naive and curious (an airhead in a cute way). Long straight silver-white hair with a neat hime cut (straight bangs, side locks), deep ruby-red eyes, a big red camellia hair ornament; a crimson furisode with white camellia and snowflake patterns, gold obi, a fluffy white fur stole around her shoulders. Expression: a graceful, slightly shy smile, hands politely together.

Upper-body portrait from the waist up at a Japanese shrine on New Year's Eve night (stone lanterns, a red torii gate softly out of focus, paper lanterns, a little snow in the air), she looks straight at the viewer with the expression described.
